# SSENSE

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 7 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Signed-out luxury retail: a 55px fixed header with a centred wordmark and 11px uppercase chrome, square black Add to bag, 2:3 product cards, grey struck-through sale prices, and a separate editorial scale in Favorit and JHA Times Now.

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out (public marketing and storefront only; login was opened and not submitted; bag, wishlist, and checkout were not entered). Themes: light.

Public signed-out surfaces of [ssense.com](https://www.ssense.com/), captured on 2026-11-19 from the Singapore English locale (`/en-sg`). The preview pane was 1169 by 731 CSS pixels at device pixel ratio 2. Only light was painted. No account was created and nothing was added to the bag.

12 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: Favorit SSENSE Inter, Favorit SSENSE Inter1, JHA Times Now, interFont.

### Fonts (from README.md)

Favorit SSENSE Inter, Favorit SSENSE Inter1, Favorit SSENSE Regular, and JHA Times Now are served as woff2 and woff from the site. They are proprietary and are not in this package. `interFont` is the family name the newer storefront computes; its file licence was not read. Tokens name the computed families. The style guide falls back to Helvetica and Arial because those families are not installed here.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

The viewport is 1169px, not 1440. Phone width was not measured, so editorial type sizes are the desktop rules that won at 1169. The article h1 computed to 49.875px; the declared `.u-font--xlarge-sans` steps are larger and were not the winning size.

Focus on the size select set `outline-color: rgb(229, 151, 0)` with `outline-style: none`. That colour is in the tokens as a focus role, and it did not paint.

`.s-button--disabled` is a declared rule (rgb(182, 182, 182)). It was not seen on a painted button. The sale price is not red. The current price stays black and the previous price is rgb(136, 136, 136) with a line through.

Hover, pressed, loading, and error were not forced. The underline hover treatment is a declared `.background-underline` rule. `transition: all` on the header and Add to bag has no duration in the computed value. Drawer duration 0.2s and main transform 0.35s were read from rules and one computed element. A reduced-motion pass was not run.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Set storefront type at 11px on 15px.** Header, listing, price, and Add to bag all compute to that size. The editorial pages use a second scale.
- **Keep corners square on the store.** Header, cards, fields, the size select, and Add to bag are 0px. The 10px radius belongs to the editorial Shop button only.
- **Use black for the action, not a brand hue.** Add to bag and Continue are rgb(0, 0, 0) with white type. No accent colour was painted on these pages.
- **Show a sale as a struck grey previous price.** The current price stays rgb(0, 0, 0). The previous price is rgb(136, 136, 136) and `line-through`.
- **Leave the wordmark as the centred SVG.** It is 104 by 21.2px, black, in a 55px fixed bar.
